Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's pin escapes in nine volumes (about 7 hours), aimed at turning defence back into offence. Volume 1 covers carrying weight on your torso versus frames, and shoulder shape (concave versus convex). Volume 2 covers fighting the far elbow, knee-to-hip contact and side guard. Volume 3 covers the leg grab / re-guard dilemma, escaping with a near-side underhook and opponents who crowd the hips. Volume 4 covers double underhooks and pummelling. Volume 5 covers escaping as they transition to north-south. Volumes 6 and 7 cover mount escapes (opponent's leg positions, bridging and shrimping, clearing underhooks, kipping to free a trapped arm). Volumes 8 and 9 are rolls with commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi players at any level who get pinned.

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's strangle escapes in eight volumes, organised by choke and by the stage of the escape. Volume 1 covers the stages of an escape. Volume 2 covers the wrong-way triangle (hantai sankaku). Volume 3 is a long section on the side triangle (yoko sankaku), from recognising danger to early and late escapes. Volume 4 covers the arm-in guillotine (rolling through, running to side control). Volume 5 covers the darce (forward roll, thumb position). Volume 6 covers the back crucifix. Volumes 7 and 8 are rolls with commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi players who get choked from triangles, guillotines and darces.

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's turtle and front headlock escapes in eight volumes. Volume 1 covers wrestling versus jiu-jitsu thinking. Volume 2 covers defending go-behinds. Volume 3 covers escaping the front headlock (sitting to half guard, clearing it with a 2-on-1 or an elbow post). Volume 4 covers escaping turtle (open versus closed turtle). Volume 5 covers head-first stand-ups (referee versus tripod, inside versus outside leg). Volume 6 covers defending a hook from turtle (diagonal control, falling to a hip). Volumes 7 and 8 are rolls with commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: Anyone who ends up in turtle or the front headlock, especially in no-gi.

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's arm lock escapes in nine volumes. Volume 1 covers the stages of escaping. Volumes 2 to 4 cover the kimura family: standard kimura (head and hand positions, body lock), T-kimura (escape directions, stripping the grip) and dorsal kimura (including the legs kimura). Volumes 5 to 7 cover armbars: top and bottom, early versus late escapes, quarter juji and three-quarter juji, figure-four and ten-finger escapes against the top hand post. Volumes 8 and 9 are rolls with commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi players who get arm-locked or kimura'd.
key: Kimura, T-kimura and dorsal kimura escapes
